name: create_datums
description: Project (v20.1): batch-create levels and grids from a levels_grids.json file. The gateway reads the file from disk and creates every level (by elevationMm) and grid (by start/end mm) in a single transaction, skipping any whose name already exists (skipExisting, default true). Returns created/skipped counts + per-item errors. Establishes the rebuild reference frame / column lines. Requires an active project document.
